title: Biotech news from around the world - Nature Biotechnology
text:
GSK plans to shut its UK R&D headquarters in Stevenage by 2029 and move its operations to a new, 300,000-square-foot site on the Cambridge Biomedical Campus. The company cited direct access to the world-class biomedical research conducted at the University of Cambridge and the surrounding science parks, as well as fully integrated drug development and commercial manufacturing scale-up capability, as reasons for the move. GSK said it will invest $540 million to support the new facility.Samsung Biologics will buy Swiss contract development and manufacturing organization PolyPeptide Group to boost its peptide, antibody and antibody–drug conjugate production, driven by the demand for obesity treatments and the expansion of peptide-based therapies into new disease areas. The $1.8-billion price tag will be the largest ever purchase by a Korean biopharma company.
